title: rapps variables
description: Configuration variables for the ReactOS Applications Manager (rapps) component

RAPPS_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Installation strategy for rapps ('libscript_native' stages isolated rapps-db catalog and CLI wrapper, 'system' uses native rapps.exe).

RAPPS_VERSION.description: Specific version or branch alias of rapps / rapps-db to install.

RAPPS_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading the rapps-db package catalog archive.

RAPPS_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying available rapps / ReactOS release tags.

RAPPS_FETCH_UPSTREAM_DB.description: Set to '1' to download and overlay the upstream GitHub rapps-db archive during native setup.

LIBSCRIPT_RAPPS_VERSION.description: Target rapps catalog version override when invoked from ReactOS distribution profiles.

LIBSCRIPT_RAPPS_DB_URL.description: Upstream archive URL for the ReactOS Applications Manager package database (rapps-db).

LIBSCRIPT_RAPPS_DB_DIR.description: Filesystem directory containing extracted RAPPS .txt INI package definitions.

LIBSCRIPT_RAPPS_CACHE_DIR.description: Destination directory for pre-fetched and verified RAPPS application installers.

LIBSCRIPT_RAPPS_ARCH.description: Target PE CPU architecture used when resolving architecture-specific RAPPS sections.
